metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 1979 · Apocalypse Now

metas.description: A man who loves games and theater invites his wife's lover to meet him, setting up a battle of wits with potentially deadly results.

metas.description: A paranoid, secretive surveillance expert has a crisis of conscience when he suspects that the couple he is spying on will be murdered.
